_comment: Arogya Link — red_flags.json | Deterministic Red-Flag Rules Skeleton
_instructions: Replace this skeleton with the complete clinical red-flag rule set before Phase 5.
Each rule is DETERMINISTIC — same input always produces the same output.
Gemini (LLM) must NEVER read or modify severity levels from this file.
RedFlagEngine reads this file at startup.
Do NOT store patient PII in this file.
All rules must be evidence-backed: specify the exact answer field/value that triggers them.

rules.label: Chest pain — possible cardiac emergency
rules.evidence_template: Patient reported chest pain or tightness as chief complaint.

rules.label: Difficulty breathing — urgent review required
rules.evidence_template: Patient reported difficulty breathing as chief complaint.

rules.label: Fever persisting more than one week
rules.evidence_template: Patient reported fever lasting more than one week.
